sources.entry: LyricGlow - Synced lyrics player with word-by-word glow effects. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/ateymoori/lyricglow) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]
LyricGlow - macOS application displaying synchronized lyrics with animated word-by-word glow effects for Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube Music.

summary.one_liner: LyricGlow is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that shows synced, word-by-word karaoke lyrics for the track playing in Spotify or Apple Music, with optional translation into 43 languages.
summary.what_it_does: It reads the current track from the Spotify or Apple Music desktop app using AppleScript and fetches synced lyrics from LRCLIB. Lyrics are shown in a frameless, always-on-top Liquid Glass window with a 3-line view and a word-by-word glow, and the current line also appears in the menu bar. A Floating Lyrics mode turns the window into a click-through line on the desktop. The app can translate each lyric line (Google Translate web endpoint, with Lingva Translate as fallback) and supports RTL rendering for Persian, Arabic and Hebrew. It also shows artist bio, images and album art from TheAudioDB, and optional Spotify top tracks and albums after login. Data is cached on disk for 7 days by default.
use_cases: Karaoke-style lyrics while listening to Spotify or Apple Music
Showing live lyrics in the macOS menu bar
Desktop lyric overlay on top of other windows
Translating song lyrics into another language in real time
Learning a language by reading lyrics alongside translation
Viewing artist bio and album art for the current track
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | bash  (one-line installer from the README; URL was missing in the source)
Manual: download LyricGlow-arm64.dmg or LyricGlow-x64.dmg from Releases and drag to Applications
Developers: git clone, cd lyricglow, npm install
notable: Word-by-word glow lyrics synced to playback in a floating window and in the menu bar
Built-in translation into 43 languages with RTL support
Floating Lyrics overlay that is click-through and stays above full-screen apps
No account, no analytics; lyrics and metadata cached locally
Signed and notarized builds distributed via Homebrew cask
caveats: macOS only (music detection relies on AppleScript); Windows/Linux not supported
Requires the Spotify or Apple Music desktop app and macOS 11.0+
Spotify top tracks and albums require the app owner to hold Spotify Premium and a dev-mode client ID
